priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup function
findings.body: Calling the returned disposer no longer detaches the `"message"` handler. Any long-lived socket that repeatedly attaches and disposes handlers will retain them indefinitely, causing callbacks after teardown, duplicate processing, and unbounded listener/closure memory growth.

findings.title: [P1] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) and returns an empty disposer at diff line 3, so cleanup neither removes the listener nor prevents callbacks and retention after teardown.
